v1.35 Caddy 可重现构建记录 / Caddy reproducible build record
===================================

Project version: v1.35. Commands, paths and verification values below are shared
by both languages. Dated validation records are preserved from that verification;
this documentation review does not claim a new runtime test or attestation run.
The exact runtime/build version is an existing binary identity, not an alternate
project release name; preserve it when reproducing the bundled binary.

Runtime version (exact existing binary identifier):
  v2.11.4-V1.35-go1.27.1-fix8v9

Upstream source:
  https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy
  tag: v2.11.4
  commit: e2eee6a7fce366321294c9c2a79f3146891dcbdf

Toolchain:
  Go 1.27.1
  CGO_ENABLED=0
  GOOS=linux
  GOARCH=amd64 or arm64

Exact module graph:
  Copy Caddy-go.mod to the upstream source root as go.mod.
  Copy Caddy-go.sum to the upstream source root as go.sum.
  Apply Caddy-cel-go-0.30.patch to adapt Caddy v2.11.4 to the cel-go v0.30
  InterpretableV2 API. This is the same compatibility update used by newer
  upstream Caddy code.

Security dependency updates relative to upstream v2.11.4 include:
  github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 v5.3.0
  github.com/google/cel-go v0.30.0
  github.com/klauspost/compress v1.18.7
  go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.44.0
  go.opentelemetry.io/otel/metric v1.44.0
  go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace v1.44.0
  golang.org/x/crypto v0.56.0
  golang.org/x/net v0.57.0
  golang.org/x/text v0.41.0
  google.golang.org/grpc v1.82.1

Build command (replace ARCH with amd64 or arm64):
  GOTOOLCHAIN=local CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=ARCH \
    go build -p 4 -mod=readonly -trimpath -buildvcs=false \
    -ldflags='-s -w -buildid= -X github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2.CustomVersion=v2.11.4-V1.35-go1.27.1-fix8v9' \
    -o caddy_linux_ARCH ./cmd/caddy

SHA-256:
  amd64  9733bf44efa76a9c3cccd705e4f6cd4c91a760a11c0e3f5b46efc91ae6a762da
  arm64  c8c4fc95aa9ccfed022059b7613b170f1614aa1da3b675762b8ec2ae443d91be

Reproducibility (2026-09-12):
  Both amd64 and arm64 were rebuilt from the same source, module files,
  generated assets, Go 1.27.1 toolchain and flags with a fresh GOCACHE.
  Each rebuilt binary matched the bundled bytes (cmp exit 0) and SHA-256 above.
  The recorded builds used -p 4, CGO_ENABLED=0, -mod=readonly, -trimpath,
  -buildvcs=false and -ldflags='-s -w -buildid=' plus the CustomVersion value.

Validation (2026-09-12):
  go vet ./... passed. The complete normal suite (go test -p 1 -timeout 180s
  -count=1 ./...) passed 1,070 test/subtest runs. The focused race suite for
  ./cmd/caddy ./caddyconfig/caddyfile ./modules/caddyhttp passed 159 runs.
  No executed test case was skipped; skip events were packages without tests.
  The initial full-suite run inherited HTTP proxy settings and failed local
  PROXY-protocol integration tests. Those tests and the complete suite passed
  after proxy variables were unset; no assertions or test exclusions changed.

  The actual bundled Caddy plus compiled helper passed 115/115 security boundary
  checks against a controlled media backend. Coverage includes HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2,
  HTTP/3, authority/SNI/port enforcement, TLS 1.3, route restrictions, security
  headers, source/credential stripping and WHEP limits/ownership. This fixture
  does not claim real codec, ingest or live weak-network playback coverage.
  Runtime acceptance and its limits are recorded in the accompanying upgrade
  report. Native arm64 execution is separate from the verified cross-build.

Vulnerability audit (2026-09-12):
  govulncheck v1.8.0 used Go 1.27.1 and the vulnerability database updated at
  2026-09-10T14:48:42Z. The ./cmd/caddy source-entry scan reported one module-only
  finding, GO-2026-5932 in x/crypto v0.56.0, with no affected imported-package
  or callable-symbol finding at that executable entry.

  Both binary scans retain OpenPGP module/package/symbol findings for that same
  GO-2026-5932 advisory. The database describes an unmaintained API with known
  security issues and no fixed version. These are not zero-warning binaries;
  the source-entry result does not erase retained binary findings. A symbol
  match alone does not establish a runtime call path. JSON-mode exit 0 means
  scan completion, not the absence of findings.

License:
  See Caddy-LICENSE.txt.

中文说明（与上文共用命令、依赖清单和 SHA-256）
================================================

本项目版本为 v1.35。实际 Caddy 二进制版本字符串是
v2.11.4-V1.35-go1.27.1-fix8v9；它是既有构建标识，重现当前二进制时必须原样保留，
不作为项目文档的版本名称。

源码与工具链：
  上游仓库、v2.11.4 标签和固定提交见上文。使用 Go 1.27.1，禁用 CGO，
  目标为 Linux amd64 或 arm64。把 Caddy-go.mod/go.sum 复制为上游根目录的
  go.mod/go.sum，再应用 Caddy-cel-go-0.30.patch，以适配 cel-go v0.30 的
  InterpretableV2 API；该兼容方式与较新上游 Caddy 代码一致。
  上方完整列出的依赖版本是相对上游 v2.11.4 的安全依赖更新，须按随包依赖图保留。
  构建命令中的 ARCH 替换为 amd64 或 arm64；其余参数和 CustomVersion 保持原样。

可重现性记录（2026-09-12）：
  两个架构均使用相同源码、模块文件、生成资源、Go 1.27.1 和参数，以全新 GOCACHE
  重建。每个重建产物均与随包二进制逐字节一致（cmp 退出 0），SHA-256 见上文。
  参数包括 -p 4、CGO_ENABLED=0、-mod=readonly、-trimpath、-buildvcs=false、
  -ldflags='-s -w -buildid=' 以及准确的 CustomVersion 值。

验证记录（2026-09-12）：
  go vet ./... 通过；完整普通测试 go test -p 1 -timeout 180s -count=1 ./...
  通过 1,070 个测试/子测试；./cmd/caddy、./caddyconfig/caddyfile、
  ./modules/caddyhttp 的定向 race 测试通过 159 个。没有跳过已执行测试用例，
  skip 事件是没有测试文件的包。
  初次完整测试继承了 HTTP 代理，导致本地 PROXY 协议集成测试失败；清除代理后，
  这些用例和完整套件均通过，未修改断言或排除用例。

  实际随包 Caddy 和编译后的 helper 在受控媒体后端上通过 115/115 安全边界检查，
  包括 HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2、HTTP/3、authority/SNI/端口约束、TLS 1.3、路由限制、
  安全响应头、来源/凭据剥离和 WHEP 限额/会话归属。该夹具不覆盖真实编解码、
  推流或实时弱网播放。运行时验收和限制见随附升级报告；arm64 原生执行需要
  单独验证，不能由交叉编译结果推断。本次文档整理不代表重新执行上述运行测试。

漏洞审计记录（2026-09-12）：
  govulncheck v1.8.0 使用 Go 1.27.1 和更新至 2026-09-10T14:48:42Z 的数据库。
  ./cmd/caddy 源码入口报告一个模块级发现：x/crypto v0.56.0 的 GO-2026-5932；
  该入口没有受影响导入包或可调用符号发现。
  两个二进制扫描仍有同一公告的 OpenPGP 模块/包/符号发现。数据库描述的是一个
  停止维护、存在已知安全问题且没有修复版本的 API，因此不能称为零警告二进制。
  源码入口扫描不会抹去二进制发现，单独匹配符号也不能证明存在运行时调用路径。
  JSON 模式退出 0 仅表示扫描完成，不表示没有漏洞发现。

许可证：
  见 Caddy-LICENSE.txt；法律文本保持原样。
